rationale: Adds headless pointer/keyboard replay (--click/--drag/--key plus a required --interaction-log) to the development-only pulp-design-ir-observe tool and a checked-in controls DesignIR test fixture. The observer only reads an existing DesignIR and records replay outcomes; no importer, DesignIR schema, Chromium capture, rendering, or packaging behavior changes, and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves. It supplies the Pulp-side observation used by the Vellum parity harness under the 2026-10-04 temporary Pulp exception.
